sentences.en: Muslims are portrayed in a different light by Western media.
sentences.zh: 1. 西方媒体以不同的视角描绘穆斯林。

sentences.en: Sami still likes to portray himself as an innocent victim.
sentences.zh: 2. 塞米仍然喜欢把自己描述成一个无辜的受害者。

sentences.en: He portrayed himself to be a protector of the innocent.
sentences.zh: 3. 他自诩为无辜者的保护者。

senses.zh: 描绘，描写；（在艺术或文学作品中）描述，刻画；（在电影、戏剧等中）扮演
